title: feat(runtime): export resolveArtifactCollections, the reader of every collection of a composed suite
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DHwAvbzPP7kQnGnKWz68yKA)_
Fixes #32827
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：`@objectstack/runtime` 新导出一个函数 `resolveArtifactCollections`，它把「按包保留」方式组合出来的套件里，每个包各自的对象、应用、流程、翻译、钩子等合成一份完整视图。函数本身早已存在、启动时就在用，这次只是公开出来，没有新逻辑。
- **为什么改**：#32810 之后，把多个各带一个应用的包「扁平组合」会被拒绝；hotcrm 的测试视图正是靠扁平组合拿全套集合。公开这个读取器后，hotcrm 可以改成 `resolveArtifactCollections(composeStacks(包列表, { manifest: 'preserve' }))`，不用在应用里自己抄一份合并逻辑。
- **风险与回滚**：纯新增导出，已有调用和已有产物不受影响(没有 `packages[]` 的产物原样返回)；回滚即撤回 `index.ts` 的一行导出。
- **先看**：① `packages/runtime/src/index.ts` 新增的导出行；② `packages/runtime/src/artifact-collections.public-reader.test.ts`(从包入口导入，对比扁平组合的内容)；③ `artifact-collections.ts` 的文档注释。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/artifact-collections.public-reader.test.ts`，预期 1 个文件 2 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/runtime/src/index.ts`: exports `resolveArtifactCollections` from `./artifact-collections.js`. One export line; the merge itself is the existing one the boot paths read (`app-plugin.ts`, `load-artifact-bundle.ts`, `standalone-stack.ts`, `app-artifact-handlers.ts`, `resolve-project-database.ts`). No second copy.
- `packages/runtime/src/artifact-collections.ts`: docblock only. `resolveArtifactCollections` gains a "Public reader" section that teaches the consumer use, `resolveArtifactCollections(composeStacks(packageStacks, { manifest: 'preserve' }))`, and says why a flat composition is not the route (it puts every package's app under one package id, which `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION` refuses for a suite, ADR-0019 D3 as amended). The note on `packageOwnedCollectionKeys` that said neither function is importable from `@objectstack/runtime` is corrected: that one stays module scope.
- `packages/runtime/src/artifact-collections.public-reader.test.ts` (new): the consumer-side pin. A `manifest: 'preserve'` composition of one `app` package and two `module` packages, read through the reader imported from the package entry (`./index`), yields every input's objects, apps, flows, translations and hooks with the contents a flat composition gave. It also pins that the entry's export IS the module's function (no second copy).
- `.changeset/runtime-export-artifact-collections-reader.md`: `@objectstack/runtime` patch, both declaration lines.

## Tests

- New pin: 2 tests. With the existing `artifact-collections.test.ts`: 2 files, 24 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: 589 files passed, 10253 tests passed, 19 skipped (run at merge head f58a4da7; the later commit only adds one side-effect import to the new test file, re-run green).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime run typecheck` (includes `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- Ablations (each one-shot through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proved by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`; the test resolves the source entry, so no dist leg):
  - Drop the export line from `index.ts`: both new tests red.
  - Make the reader skip the merge (`if (declared === undefined || 'ABLATED_MERGE') return artifact;`): the consumer test red, `objects: expected [] to deeply equal [ Array(3) ]`; the identity test stays green.
- Forward check against #32810: with the spec half of branch `claude/project-thread-2eliu6` applied (`git apply` of its three-dot spec diff) and `@objectstack/spec` rebuilt, both reader files stay green (24/24), while a flat composition of an `app` and a `module` package with one app each is refused `STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION` 422 on that build. The pin's flat baseline is taken without the apps for exactly this reason. Tree restored and spec rebuilt from this branch afterwards.
- Built entries, probed by hand after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime build`:
  - `node -e "const m=require('./dist/index.cjs');console.log('cjs', typeof m.resolveArtifactCollections)"` prints `cjs function`.
  - `node --input-type=module -e "const m=await import('./dist/index.js');console.log('esm', typeof m.resolveArtifactCollections)"` prints `esm function`.
  - `grep -c resolveArtifactCollections dist/index.d.ts dist/index.d.cts` prints `5` for each.

## Acceptance notes

- `check:api-surface` is a `packages/spec` gate (`packages/spec/api-surface/*.json`); `@objectstack/runtime` has no api-surface baseline, so there is nothing to regenerate for this export.
- No `content/docs/**` page documents this reader today, so no docs edit.
- Out of scope, reported only: hotcrm's `test/helpers/composed-stack.ts` moves to the preserve composition plus this reader in the hotcrm lane, after the `@objectstack/*` bump that carries this export.

## Verification

Local gates at head 3a3fc0b8f6 (merge of origin/main at f58a4da7), file `gates-ran-3a3fc0b8.txt`:

<details><summary>dispatch-gates --ran: 60 derived, 58 run, 2 NOT MEASURED</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran FILE`: exit 0, `60 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 58 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.
- NOT MEASURED, exit 3, prerequisite not met in this container (CI runs both):
  - `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`: its fixture is pinned to a commit a shallow clone cannot reach (the gate asks for `git fetch --unshallow origin main`).
  - `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: it reads built output and 41 packages had no `dist/` (only the runtime dependency closure was built). The runtime's own CJS and ESM entries were probed by hand instead, output under Tests.
- `check:test-source-alias` was red once at f58a4da7: the entry import reaches `@objectstack/metadata` through a dynamic import inside a clocked case. Fixed per the gate's prescription with a module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata';` (the convention other runtime tests follow); re-run exit 0, with the test-file-reading gates (`nul-bytes`, `cross-package-test-inputs`, `registry-log-declared`, `rest-log-spy-declared`, `refd-timer-probe`, `type-check-debt`, `logger-receiver-detach`, `tier-file-adoption`, `undeclared-dep-imports`), all exit 0.
- Also run, outside the derivation: `pnpm lint` exit 0; `check:authz-resolver`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, `check:route-ledger-census` exit 0.

</details>
